dsp GenSubSawLeadBp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.9
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1f * 1.6) * 0.9) * 0.7779

dsp GenSubSawLeadHp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.9
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 0.9 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 1.1481

  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.2 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.994 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let dt2 := min(0.4, f * 1.006 / sr)
    set ph2 := fract(ph2 + dt2)

    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.2 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.994 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let dt2 := min(0.4, f * 1.006 / sr)
    set ph2 := fract(ph2 + dt2)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) + (ph1 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph1, dt1), (ph1 / dt1) * 2.0 - (ph1 / dt1) * (ph1 / dt1) - 1.0, select(gt(ph1, 1.0 - dt1), ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) + ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) + (ph2 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph2, dt2), (ph2 / dt2) * 2.0 - (ph2 / dt2) * (ph2 / dt2) - 1.0, select(gt(ph2, 1.0 - dt2), ((ph2 - 1.0) / dt2) * ((ph2 - 1.0) / dt2) + ((ph2 - 1.0) / dt2) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 0.333333 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.3) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.3
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1f * 1.6) * 0.9) * 1.4771

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.2 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.994 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let dt2 := min(0.4, f * 1.006 / sr)
    set ph2 := fract(ph2 + dt2)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) + (ph1 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph1, dt1), (ph1 / dt1) * 2.0 - (ph1 / dt1) * (ph1 / dt1) - 1.0, select(gt(ph1, 1.0 - dt1), ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) + ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) + (ph2 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph2, dt2), (ph2 / dt2) * 2.0 - (ph2 / dt2) * (ph2 / dt2) - 1.0, select(gt(ph2, 1.0 - dt2), ((ph2 - 1.0) / dt2) * ((ph2 - 1.0) / dt2) + ((ph2 - 1.0) / dt2) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 0.333333 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.3) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.3
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))

    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f

    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 1.3 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 1.7677

dsp GenSubSawPluckLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.7
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6577

  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.997 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.003 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) + (ph1 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph1, dt1), (ph1 / dt1) * 2.0 - (ph1 / dt1) * (ph1 / dt1) - 1.0, select(gt(ph1, 1.0 - dt1), ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) + ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 0.5 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))

    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6595

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.997 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.003 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) + (ph1 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph1, dt1), (ph1 / dt1) * 2.0 - (ph1 / dt1) * (ph1 / dt1) - 1.0, select(gt(ph1, 1.0 - dt1), ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) + ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 0.5 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1f * 1.6) * 0.9) * 0.8634

dsp GenSubSawBrassHp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.997 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.003 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) + (ph1 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph1, dt1), (ph1 / dt1) * 2.0 - (ph1 / dt1) * (ph1 / dt1) - 1.0, select(gt(ph1, 1.0 - dt1), ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) + ((ph1 - 1.0) / dt1) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 0.5 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 1.2 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 1.3430

dsp GenSubSquarePluckLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    let q0 := fract(ph0 + 0.5)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := (((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) - (q0 * 2.0 - 1.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.7
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.4530

dsp GenSubPulsePluckLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    let q0 := fract(ph0 + 0.18)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := (((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0))) - (q0 * 2.0 - 1.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.7
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6355

    set fenv := fenvA

    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.7
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f

    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 0.7 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 1.0420

dsp GenSubTriBassLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((1.0 - abs(ph0 * 4.0 - 2.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 1800.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.1
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6283
